shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
raised arm or limb bent at an angle
curved linear contours defining a body
justification: Both show a single large figure in shallow relief occupying the surface with a raised, bent limb, but A is an extremely schematic, thin-lined animal-like creature with a small head and bare outlined body, while B is a densely detailed anthropomorphic winged figure with a horned headdress, patterned beard, feathered wing and a held object. The only correspondence is the generic idea of a profile creature in relief; the specific forms, attributes and rendering conventions (linear incision versus modelled, texture-filled relief) are entirely unlike.
